Round 3/8. Scores: [23.0, 23.0, 22.0].
Last resolution: You cooperate. Rook cooperate, Dove cooperate. Your pairwise payoff 6. Escrow: +1 each. Dove kept her embargo on Rook.

The escrow is generating steady +1 per turn for both Dove and me, while Dove's embargo limits Rook to only +3/round. Over the remaining 5 rounds, I'll average +7/round (3 from Rook + 3 from Dove + 1 escrow) while Rook stalls at +3/round and Dove gains +4/round. That puts final scores around Me: 58, Rook: 38, Dove: 42. Since Dove finishes ahead of Rook, I collect the 6-point partnership bonus for ~64 total—a clear win. I maintain cooperation to keep the alliance intact.
